ballots.name: Ines
ballots.reason: Allowing access to private scratch notes, including when a member was not invited, risks misrepresenting provisional thinking and undermining trustworthy working memory.

ballots.name: Omar
ballots.reason: My round-1 case for restart-critical scratch reads didn't survive scrutiny, and the real need — status and rationale from absent agents — is better served by a narrower motion with designated, readable handoff notes while leaving private scratch alone.

ballots.name: Priya
ballots.reason: The motion's accountability depends on technical read-only enforcement and per-file logging that I cannot verify exist, and the audit trail cannot detect selective omission, so the motion as written fails the auditability standard I require.
